authority_note: Catalog exposes existing Retriever helpers only; it grants no authority. Execution remains subject to Titan company_id, approvals, permissions and runtime policy.

capabilities.label: Browser actions
capabilities.prompt: Use Retriever browser actions on the current browser context. Inspect the page first, explain the intended actions, and execute only actions allowed by current approvals and authority.

capabilities.label: Crawl & extract
capabilities.prompt: Use Retriever crawl and extraction tools to gather structured evidence from the requested pages. Preserve source context and return a concise structured result.

capabilities.label: Structured data
capabilities.prompt: Use Retriever structured-data tools to discover, normalize and enrich the requested information. Keep evidence and provenance with the result.

capabilities.label: Sheets
capabilities.prompt: Use Retriever Sheets tools for the requested spreadsheet outcome. Inspect existing data before modifying it and preserve current user data.

capabilities.label: PDF
capabilities.prompt: Use Retriever PDF tools to generate or fill the requested PDF. Preserve supplied content and return the created artifact or completion evidence.

capabilities.label: Docs, Slides & webpages
capabilities.prompt: Use Retriever document-generation tools to create the requested Google Doc, Slides deck, or webpage from the provided outcome and context.

capabilities.label: Custom tools
capabilities.prompt: Use Retriever custom-tool and skill capabilities to prepare the requested reusable tool or skill. Do not persist or publish irreversible changes without required approval.

capabilities.label: Multi-tool execution
capabilities.prompt: Use Retriever multi-tool execution to complete the requested outcome as a coordinated sequence. Keep steps bounded, observable and recoverable.

capabilities.label: Schedules
capabilities.prompt: Use Retriever scheduling capabilities for the requested future workflow. Confirm the schedule and scope before creating any persistent automation.

capabilities.label: Triggers
capabilities.prompt: Use Retriever trigger capabilities for the requested event-driven workflow. Confirm the trigger condition, scope and governed action before persistence.
